exp-single.caption: The rectangle $-1<\operatorname{Re}z<1,\ 0<\operatorname{Im}z<3.142$ (grey) and its image under $F(z)=e^{z}$ (checkerboard), joined by the homotopy $H_t(z)=(e^{tz}-1)/t+t$ for $0<t\le 1$, $H_0(z)=z$. Arrows are the paths $t\mapsto H_t(z)$ of 11 boundary points and 9 interior points, from $z$ (dot) to $F(z)$. Regions are shaded by a checkerboard of cell $0.2$ in the $z$-plane, carried by the map.

ex-strip-single.caption: The set $\left|\operatorname{Im} z\right| < \frac{\pi}{2}$ and the line $\operatorname{Im}z=0.8$ (grey) and its image under $F(z)=\frac{e^{z}-1}{e^{z}+1}$ (checkerboard), joined by the homotopies of the steps in turn (on $k-1\le t\le k$ the homotopy of $f_k$ at time $t-k+1$): for $f_{1}$, the homotopy $H_t(z)=(e^{tz}-1)/t+t$ for $0<t\le 1$, $H_0(z)=z$; for $f_{2}$, the elliptic M\"obius transformations $H_t$ that fix $p=i$ and $q=-i$, with $H_t'(p)=e^{-\pi i t/2}$. Arrows are the paths $t\mapsto H_t(z)$ of 4 boundary points and 6 interior points, from $z$ (dot) to $F(z)$. Regions are shaded by a checkerboard of cell $1$ in the $z$-plane, carried by the map. Dashed boundaries do not belong to the sets.
